sections.title: 主要结果
sections.text:
《Multi-task contrastive learning for automatic CT and X-ray diagnosis of COVID-19》：结果的原文依据；数值与适用人群以引文为准。

【Abstract · abstract-1-10】Experimental results demonstrate that contrastive learning (as plugin module) brings solid accuracy improvement for deep learning models on both CT (5.49%-6.45%) and X-ray (0.96%-2.42%) without requiring additional annotations.

evidence.text: Experimental results demonstrate that contrastive learning (as plugin module) brings solid accuracy improvement for deep learning models on both CT (5.49%-6.45%) and X-ray (0.96%-2.42%) without requiring additional annotations.
